blocks.text: Use means the appropriate or prescribed use of drugs for medical purposes; abuse generally means the inappropriate use of psychoactive drugs.

blocks.text: Withdrawal symptoms of drug abuse include anxiety, depression, fatigue, agitation, mood swings, shakiness or tremors, headache, sweating, nausea, loss of appetite, insomnia, rapid heart rate, high blood pressure, hallucinations (visual, auditory or tactile) and seizures.
